# Embeddable Widgets — Frontend

Companion to [00-overview.md](00-overview.md). Three deliverables: the **loader** a host site includes, the **embed page** rendered inside the iframe, and the **admin page** where a widget is configured.

## 1. Loader — `frontend/packages/widget-loader`

A framework-free TypeScript package built with Vite library mode to a classic IIFE (`target: es2019`, no polyfills, no dependencies, budget **≤ 5 kB gzipped**, enforced by a size test). Classic script rather than an ES module so it works in every CMS script module and with `async`.

### Snippet (generated by the admin page)

```html
<script async src="https://eneo.kommun.se/widget/v1/eneo.js"
        data-widget-id="wgt_3f8k…" data-lang="sv"></script>
```

Optional attributes: `data-position`, `data-color-scheme`, `data-auto-open="false"`, `data-launcher="none"` (host renders its own button and calls `Eneo.open()`). A pinned variant `/widget/v1.4.2/eneo.js` with an `integrity` hash is offered for hosts that require SRI; the floating `v1` URL must not carry SRI because it would break on every release.

### Runtime behaviour

1. Registers `<eneo-widget>` (custom element). When loaded with `data-widget-id` it appends one instance to `<body>`; SPA hosts can instead render `<eneo-widget widget-id="…">` themselves.
2. The element's **shadow root** holds only the launcher (`<button aria-expanded aria-controls aria-haspopup="dialog">` with visible text or an SVG with `<title>`), an unread badge and the panel container. Styles are scoped by the shadow root; the host's CSS cannot reach them and vice versa. `:host { all: initial }` guards inherited properties.
3. The panel is an `<iframe title="Chatt med kommunens AI-assistent" src="…/embed/wgt_…?origin=<host origin>&lang=…&scheme=…" allow="clipboard-write" referrerpolicy="strict-origin" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox">`. The iframe is created on first open (or on `requestIdleCallback` after a `<link rel="preconnect">` when `data-prefetch="true"`), never on page load, so the widget adds no request to pages where nobody chats.
4. Public API, with a pre-init command queue so calls before the script loads are not lost:

```js
window.Eneo = window.Eneo || function () { (window.Eneo.q = window.Eneo.q || []).push(arguments) };
Eneo('open'); Eneo('close'); Eneo('toggle');
Eneo('on', 'opened' | 'closed' | 'conversation_started' | 'ready', cb);
Eneo('setContext', { page_url, page_title });   // phase 5, opt-in per widget
```

5. `postMessage` protocol, versioned and origin-checked in both directions (`{ ns: 'eneo-widget', v: 1, type, payload }`): iframe → loader `ready`, `resize {height}`, `close`, `unread {count}`, `conversation_started` (no payload: the host never learns a conversation id); loader → iframe `open`, `theme {scheme}`, `context`. The loader accepts messages only when `event.source === iframe.contentWindow && event.origin === <eneo origin>`; the embed page accepts only `event.origin === <origin param>`.
6. Keyboard and focus: `Escape` anywhere inside the iframe (not only in the textarea) posts `close`; the loader hides the panel and returns focus to the launcher. Opening moves focus into the iframe (`iframe.focus()` then the embed page focuses the composer on `open`). Launcher and panel respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
7. Layout: fixed panel `min(400px, 100vw − 2rem)` × `min(700px, 100dvh − 6rem)`; below 640 px it becomes full-screen with `100dvh` and listens to `visualViewport` so the composer stays above the on-screen keyboard. `z-index` is a documented CSS custom property (`--eneo-widget-z`, default 2147483000) instead of a hard-coded max.

### Serving — `routes/widget/[version]/eneo.js/+server.ts`

The package build emits `eneo.<semver>.js`; the route maps `v1` → latest `1.x` and exact versions → immutable files, and sets `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600` (floating) or `immutable, max-age=31536000` (pinned), `Content-Type: text/javascript`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. Version and SRI hashes are read from a generated manifest so the admin snippet endpoint can print them.

## 2. Embed page — `routes/(public)/embed/[publicId]`

### `+page.server.ts`

- Fetches `GET /api/v1/widgets/{publicId}/config/` server-side (cached 60 s). 404 → a small "This chat is not available" page with no branding leak.
- Sets `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' <origins>`; wildcard origins become CSP host sources (`https://*.kommun.se`). With `?mode=full` (stand-alone page) it sets `frame-ancestors 'self'`. This is the hook the Phase-0 hardening leaves for the `/embed` prefix.
- Sets `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, and disables the app's Link-preload header logic for this route.
- Passes `hostOrigin` (from `?origin=`), `lang` (config `language` or host `?lang`), `scheme`.

### `+page.svelte` and the chat surface

- No Eneo session, no `(app)` layout. A dedicated `WidgetAppContext` provides what `ConversationView` reads from `getAppContext()`: an anonymous user with no permissions, attachments disabled, feature flags off. The February-2026 prototype (`timfork/wip/feature-widget-generator-message-editing`) proved that `ConversationView` can render with a dummy user; Phase 2 replaces that hack with a proper context boundary and, where a component reaches into `(app)`-only state, splits it (tracked in the phase's task list rather than guessed here).
- `ChatPartner` is a `WidgetChatPartner` derived from the public config: `type: 'assistant'`, `id: publicId`, `name`, no tools, no MCP, no attachments.
- API client: `createWidgetClient({ baseUrl, publicId, getToken })` in eneo-js exposes a `conversations` namespace with the same shape the `ChatService` drives (`ask`, `get`, `preflight`, …), so the service runs unchanged; the SSE reader is shared with the signed-in conversations endpoint (`endpoints/conversation-stream.js`). The visible chat is a lean widget UI (`lib/features/widget/components/`) rather than `ConversationView`, which depends on the signed-in app context, attachments and knowledge features.
- **Proof of work:** the `altcha` widget element in invisible mode, hidden from assistive technology, is verified on the first send; its payload mints the visitor token (`lib/features/widget/altcha.ts`, `visitorSession.ts`).
- **Lazy identity:** nothing is minted or stored until the visitor sends a message. Focusing the composer pre-fetches the ALTCHA challenge; the first send solves it in a Web Worker, mints the visitor token, stores `visitor_id` in `localStorage` (partitioned per host site by the browser), and only then persists anything. Token rotation is silent via `previous_token`; a `visitor_token_stale` response re-mints; `widget_not_active` shows the paused state.
- Session restore: on load with a stored `visitor_id` and a recent `session_id`, the page mints (previous token if fresh, else challenge) and calls `GET sessions/{id}/` to restore history.
- Theming: `theme.primary_color` becomes a CSS custom property that maps onto Eneo's semantic tokens (`bg-accent-default`, `text-on-fill` …); `color_scheme` sets `data-theme`; contrast is checked at config time in the admin page (see below) so the embed page never renders a non-compliant colour.
- i18n through paraglide (`sv`, `en`); `<html lang>` follows the resolved language.
- Sources: answers carry numbered citation pills (`WidgetInref.svelte`) that open a collapsed "N sources" list under the message (`WidgetMessage.svelte`), one entry per cited document. Web pages link out with their host shown; uploaded documents have no link, so the visitor can copy a reference (title plus `<eneo origin>/documents/<id>`) and quote it to an administrator. The `(app)/documents/[id]` route resolves that link for signed-in users with read access and tells everyone else whom to ask. A widget with `show_sources` off renders neither pills nor list, and the backend already stripped the references from its stream and session restore. Tool activity (which tools and MCP servers an answer used) follows `show_tool_activity` the same way: the tools always run, the backend drops the tool-call events and persisted tool calls when it is off, and citations a tool produced still arrive.
- Disclosure: the `subtitle` text (an AI disclosure by default) renders in the header on every load and cannot be dismissed; `footer_text` with the optional `footer_link_url`/`footer_link_label` render in the panel footer.

### Accessibility acceptance (WCAG 2.2 AA / EN 301 549)

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| 1.3.1, 4.1.2 | launcher is a real button with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`; message list is `role="log"`; each message has a visually hidden author label |
| 4.1.3 | streaming answers are **not** announced token by token; one `aria-live="polite"` region announces "Svar klart" and errors |
| 2.1.1, 2.1.2 | everything keyboard operable; `Escape` closes; no trap — focus can leave the iframe to the host page with Tab |
| 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 2.4.11 | focus into composer on open, back to launcher on close; visible focus rings from the design system; the panel never covers a focused host element (it is a floating panel, not a modal) |
| 1.4.3, 1.4.11 | contrast enforced at configuration time; icons ≥ 3:1 |
| 1.4.4, 1.4.10 | text resizes to 200 %; reflow at 320 px (full-screen mode) |
| 2.5.8 | targets ≥ 24 × 24 px |
| 2.3.3 | `prefers-reduced-motion` disables slide/fade |
| 3.1.1, 3.1.2 | `lang` on the iframe document; language switch when `auto` |
| 2.2.1 | no timeouts visible to the visitor; token rotation is silent |

Verified with axe-core in Playwright plus a manual VoiceOver + NVDA pass before Phase 4 closes.

## 3. Admin page — Space → Assistant → "Publicera" → "Webbwidget"

- Creating a widget from an assistant lands on a three-column page: **settings** (autosaved via `useAutosave`, the existing pattern), **live preview** (the real embed page in an iframe using a preview token, with light/dark and mobile toggles), and **snippet** (copy button; floating `v1` by default, pinned+SRI on demand; also the stand-alone URL for `mode=full`).
- Settings groups: Texts (title, welcome, up to four suggested questions, AI disclosure with a sensible default, personal-data notice, privacy URL) · Appearance (primary colour with live contrast check against the surfaces it is used on, scheme, position, launcher, logo) · Placement (allowed origins with wildcard help and inline validation) · Limits (per-visitor, per-IP, daily budget with a tokens→SEK estimate from model pricing when `show_model_pricing` is on) · Privacy (retention, feedback text) · Protection (ALTCHA on/off if policy allows).
- Status bar: `Utkast` → `Aktivera` (tenant admin only; disabled with the reason if activation requirements are unmet) → `Aktiv` with `Pausa`. Pausing is one click and confirms nothing — it is the kill switch. Archiving asks.
- Usage tab: questions/day, blocked by reason, tokens, feedback ratio (charts follow `frontend/COLORS.md` and the dataviz guidance).
- All human-facing strings go through paraglide `m.*` in `en` and `sv` (CI enforces).

## 4. Testing

- Vitest (browser mode): loader element registration, command queue, postMessage origin filtering, focus return; embed page transport seam; contrast checker.
- Playwright: a **fake host page on a second origin** (`http://127.0.0.1:4174`) embedding the dev server's widget, so `frame-ancestors`, `postMessage` origin checks and keyboard flow are tested cross-origin; a negative test on a third origin proves the browser refuses to render the iframe; axe-core on the open panel in light and dark, desktop and 375 px.
- Size test on the loader bundle; Lighthouse check that the host page's CLS and LCP are unaffected before first open.
